entries.heading: DEFENSE HEALTH PROGRAM
ancestors: TITLE XV—AUTHORIZATION OF ADDITIONAL APPROPRIATIONS FOR OVERSEAS CONTINGENCY OPERATIONS
entries.text:
SEC. 1509. DEFENSE HEALTH PROGRAM.

    Funds are hereby authorized to be appropriated for the Department of 
Defense for fiscal year 2019 for expenses, not otherwise

[[Page 132 STAT. 2096]]

provided for, for the Defense Health Program, as specified in the 
funding table in section 4502.
